---
title: "Linking Data Sets"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(car)

# Read in Datasets
load("prs.Rda")
load("gait.Rda")
```

```{r}
donorid_list <- full_join(
  ca_co_genotypes,
  gait_data,
  by = "donorid") 

donorid_list |> 
  summarise(n=n())                  
```

```{r}
donorid_data <- inner_join(
  ca_co_genotypes,
  gait_data,
  by = "donorid"
)
donorid_data |> 
  summarise(n=n())    

```

```{r}
gait_prs <- left_join(
  donorid_data,
  prs_scores,
  by = "donorid")
gait_prs |> 
  select(donorid,PRS)
```
